consumer: The dialogue/condition evaluator built by conditional_t<T>::set_has_item, which asks the yes/no question 'does the actor have item c4?' by returning actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1)
scope: the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory charges and amounts), not items merely reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — its body computes a boolean possession predicate over the character actor (charges_of/has_amount) that engine dialogue/mission conditions consume as a yes/no, not for display
divergence: A brick of c4 lying on an adjacent floor tile (reachable nearby but not carried): a wrong authority that scanned reachable inventory or map state would answer YES, but the on-person possession predicate must answer NO
